2609.19721.title: LearnActCoder: Role-Aware Error Memory for Adaptive Clinical Coding Agents
2609.19721.paper_summary: Clinical coding agents repeatedly encounter the same failure modes, including unsupported codes, missed documented conditions, specificity errors, and procedure-coding convention mismatches. We introduce Learn-Then-Act, an inference-time adaptation framework that converts errors from a small labeled LEARN batch into a structured Mistake Knowledge Database (MistakeKDB). False-negative lessons are routed to a recall-oriented Coder, while false-positive lessons are routed to a precision-oriented Judge. We instantiate the framework in LearnActCoder, a Coder-Judge clinical coding pipeline with lookup-table grounding where available. On 150 matched MIMIC-III notes, structured MistakeKDB improves CPT F1 by 5.9 percentage points, while raw-example and reflection-style memories remain near the no-memory baseline; the ICD-9 improvement is not significant. On a matched MIMIC-IV cohort, memory shifts ICD-10 coding toward higher precision at a recall cost, leaving F1 statistically unchanged. Applying the same memory to 1,000 held-out MIMIC-III notes maintains a stable ICD operating point, providing scale/stability evidence. Overall, the results are consistent with structured, feedback-derived error memory being useful for adapting clinical coding behavior across cases without weight updates or changes to the underlying workflow. Absolute CPT/HCPCS performance remains low, and the system is evaluated retrospectively rather than in clinical deployment.
2609.19721.paper_summary_zh: 臨床編碼代理人反覆遇到相同的失敗模式，包括不支援的代碼、遺漏的文檔條件、特異性錯誤和程序編碼慣例不匹配。我們介紹了 Learn-Then-Act，一種推理時適應框架，它將來自小型標記 LEARN 批次的錯誤轉換為結構化的錯誤知識數據庫 (MistakeKDB)。假陰性教訓被路由到以召回為導向的編碼器，而假陽性教訓則被路由到以精確度為導向的評判者。我們在 LearnActCoder 中實現了該框架，這是一個具有查找表基礎的編碼器-評判者臨床編碼管道。對於 150 份匹配的 MIMIC-III 記錄，結構化的 MistakeKDB 將 CPT F1 提高了 5.9 個百分點，而原始示例和反思風格的記憶保持在接近無記憶基線；ICD-9 的改進則不顯著。在匹配的 MIMIC-IV 群體中，記憶將 ICD-10 編碼推向更高的精確度，但以召回為代價，F1 統計上保持不變。將相同的記憶應用於 1,000 份保留的 MIMIC-III 記錄保持了穩定的 ICD 操作點，提供了規模/穩定性的證據。總體而言，結果與結構化的、基於反饋的錯誤記憶在跨案例適應臨床編碼行為方面的有效性一致，而無需權重更新或對基礎工作流程的變更。絕對的 CPT/HCPCS 表現仍然較低，該系統是回顧性評估，而非在臨床部署中進行評估。
